description: This PHP source file defines the ModuleBuilderController class, which extends SugarController and handles numerous actions related to module building, layout editing, package management, relationship management, field and label handling, and other module builder functionalities within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes method definitions for processing requests, managing UI views, saving and deploying modules, and interacting with related components.

classes.name: ModuleBuilderController
classes.description: Controller class for managing module building activities within SuiteCRM, including layout editing, package management, relationship configuration, field management, label handling, and other module building operations. Extends SugarController and implements various action methods corresponding to different user requests.

methods.name: getModuleTitle
methods.description: Static method to return the module title string based on the request type, used in module views.

methods.name: fromModuleBuilder
methods.description: Checks if the current request originates from the Module Builder interface.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles access control checks and forwards the request to parent processing logic.

methods.name: action_editLayout
methods.description: Prepares the view for editing a layout, determines the specific layout view based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_ViewTree
methods.description: Generates and outputs a JavaScript tree view (module or studio) in response to an AJAX request.

methods.name: action_SavePackage
methods.description: Creates or updates a package based on POST data, including duplication, population, and saving operations.

methods.name: action_BuildPackage
methods.description: Builds the specified package.

methods.name: action_DeployPackage
methods.description: Handles deployment of a package: resets caches, upgrades modules, clears caches, and performs necessary installation steps.

methods.name: action_ExportPackage
methods.description: Exports package data, setting author and description information.

methods.name: action_DeletePackage
methods.description: Deletes a specified package.

methods.name: action_SaveModule
methods.description: Saves or duplicates a module within a package, updating related metadata and module lists.

methods.name: action_DeleteModule
methods.description: Deletes a specified module from a package.

methods.name: action_saveLabels
methods.description: Saves label changes via the label parser, and determines appropriate view.

methods.name: action_SaveLabel
methods.description: Saves a label and updates related modules or packages.

methods.name: action_ExportCustom
methods.description: Exports custom module data into a package.

methods.name: action_SaveField
methods.description: Saves a dynamic field, updates database schema, and rebuilds extensions and caches.

methods.name: action_saveSugarField
methods.description: Saves a standard SugarCRM field, rebuilds extensions, and clears relevant caches.

methods.name: action_RefreshField
methods.description: Reloads a field's data for editing.

methods.name: action_saveVisibility
methods.description: Saves visibility settings for fields or views.

methods.name: action_SaveRelationshipLabel
methods.description: Saves labels for a relationship.

methods.name: action_SaveRelationship
methods.description: Adds or saves relationships, rebuilds dependent modules, and clears language cache.

methods.name: action_DeleteRelationship
methods.description: Deletes a specified relationship and clears cache.

methods.name: action_SaveDropDown
methods.description: Saves dropdown options.

methods.name: action_DeleteField
methods.description: Deletes a dynamic or studio-defined field, including associated metadata, cache, and layouts.

methods.name: DeleteLabel
methods.description: Removes a label entry via the label parser.

methods.name: action_CloneField
methods.description: Prepares the form for cloning a field.

methods.name: action_SaveAssistantPref
methods.description: Saves user preference related to Module Builder assistant usage.

methods.name: action_EditProperty
methods.description: Sets up the view for editing properties.

methods.name: action_saveProperty
methods.description: Saves property label edits.

methods.name: action_editModule
methods.description: Sets up the view for editing a module.

methods.name: action_wizard
methods.description: Sets up the wizard view.

methods.name: action_saveLayout
methods.description: Saves layout layout specified in request, and optionally syncs detail and edit views.

methods.name: action_saveAndPublishLayout
methods.description: Saves and publishes layout, syncing detail view if requested.

methods.name: action_manageBackups
methods.description: Placeholder for backup management; no implementation.

methods.name: action_listViewSave
methods.description: Saves layout for list views.

methods.name: action_dashletSave
methods.description: Saves dashlet configuration.

methods.name: action_popupSave
methods.description: Saves popup view layout and clears module cache.

methods.name: action_searchViewSave
methods.description: Saves search view configuration and repairs custom search fields.

methods.name: action_editLabels
methods.description: Sets view mode for labels (module builder or studio).

methods.name: action_get_app_list_string
methods.description: Retrieves app list strings for a given key, including package-specific strings if available.

methods.name: action_history
methods.description: Sets view for history.

methods.name: resetmodule
methods.description: Sets view to reset module.

methods.name: action_savetablesort
methods.description: Saves user's sorting preferences for module list view.
